stem: A traveller takes cetirizine to relieve sneezing caused by an allergy. Cetirizine belongs to which class of drugs?

verdicts.working: Cetirizine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms.

working:
Cetirizine blocks the effects of histamine and is used to relieve allergic symptoms.

Independent check: Cetirizine is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms.
solution: Cetirizine blocks the effects of histamine, which causes allergic symptoms such as sneezing. Hence, it belongs to the class of antihistamines.
